# Nexus Intelligence Platform

> Explore a black-and-gold SaaS marketing demo with product, industry, company, resource, and demo enquiry pages. Built with XavaInf.

## About this demonstration

This is a fictional marketing demonstration. Forms and prices do not create accounts, messages, subscriptions, orders, or payments.

## Pages

- [Nexus Intelligence Platform — SaaS Website Demo](https://vibed-saas-simple.xavainf.com/): Explore a black-and-gold SaaS marketing demo with product, industry, company, resource, and demo enquiry pages. Built with XavaInf.
- [Products — Nexus SaaS Demo](https://vibed-saas-simple.xavainf.com/products): Explore the fictional Nexus product suite and illustrated workflow features in this interactive SaaS website demo.
- [Industries — Nexus SaaS Demo](https://vibed-saas-simple.xavainf.com/industries): Browse example Nexus use cases for different industries. The content illustrates a fictional SaaS marketing website.
- [Resources — Nexus SaaS Demo](https://vibed-saas-simple.xavainf.com/resources): Browse example guides and resource cards for the fictional Nexus intelligence platform.
- [Careers — Nexus SaaS Demo](https://vibed-saas-simple.xavainf.com/careers): Explore sample team values and career listings in the Nexus SaaS website demo. These are illustrative roles.
- [About — Nexus SaaS Demo](https://vibed-saas-simple.xavainf.com/about): Meet the fictional Nexus team and explore its example company story, values, and milestones.
- [Demo Enquiry — Nexus SaaS Demo](https://vibed-saas-simple.xavainf.com/contact): Try the Nexus enquiry form and its local confirmation state. This example does not send messages or create an account.
